title: CtlSecretsResponse
description: `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/secrets` — the ONLY response in this API that carries a secret value, and it is delivered ONCE: the first successful read destroys the envelope and every later read is 410 (code `not_found`, `detail` says it was delivered and when). The envelope is bound to the principal and op that minted it, lives 15 minutes (`expires_at`), is encrypted at rest with `age` to the configured recipients (or held only in daemon memory when none are configured), and is never written to the job, the audit log or any step log. The response is sent with `Cache-Control: no-store`; the admin UI shows values through a reveal-once component and never persists them. A lost value is not recoverable — the remedy is a new, audited mint.

value.description: The minted key, `token_hex(32)` shaped. Delivered once; `Cache-Control: no-store`.
